decision_notes: Lower thresholds manually reviewed. RNA minimum reduced from 500 to 300 because cells at 300-499 UMIs generally retained adequate gene complexity and independent QC metrics, whereas most 200-299 UMI cells failed the 250-feature criterion. ATAC minimum reduced from 1000 to 500 because 500-999 count nuclei showed strong TSS enrichment and FRiP. Other thresholds retained as broad safety bounds.
